name: REST API on Postgres
summary: A complete CRUD REST API over a Postgres table: list with pagination, create, read, update, and delete, with input validation and consistent JSON errors.

env.name: DATABASE_URL
env.description: Branch connection string. Injected automatically by Neon. The API reads and writes its own blocks_rest_api.todos table here.

env.name: REST_API_PAGE_SIZE
env.description: Default and maximum number of rows returned by GET /todos. Bounds the response so a large table cannot produce an unbounded payload.

operations.title: GET /todos
operations.description: HTTP — list todos, newest first, paginated by ?limit and ?offset

operations.title: POST /todos
operations.description: HTTP — create a todo from a JSON body

operations.title: GET /todos/:id
operations.description: HTTP — fetch one todo by id

operations.title: PATCH /todos/:id
operations.description: HTTP — partially update a todo's title or done flag

operations.title: DELETE /todos/:id
operations.description: HTTP — delete a todo by id
